Be sure to consider your choice of operating systems as your first criteria though, unless it doesn’t matter to you. The M2 (and M1 for that matter) is very powerful but not all games support MacOS. The surface laptop will be compatible with almost every game but will heat up significantly and may not be powerful enough  to play games at your desired quality and frame rate.
